prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic nocturnal car portrait inside a luxury sedan.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with dark green eyes, long straight dark hair parted in the middle, fair-to-light-medium skin, natural makeup, pale green ribbed top, blue denim jeans, gold pendant necklace, and white manicure.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium close-up from inside the vehicle, subject leaning naturally over the grey leather headrest with one arm resting on it and hand near cheek, face and eyes as focal point, blurred night lights outside.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional warm streetlamp and interior light, muted grey and denim palette, cool night shadows, candid intimate luxury atmosphere, visible high-ISO grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone wide-angle approximately 26mm, f/1.8–2.0, ISO 800–1600, 1/30–1/60s, shallow depth of field and realistic low-light noise.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic medium close-up portrait of an approved adult woman inside a luxury sedan at night. She has dark green eyes, long straight dark brown-black hair parted in the middle, fair-to-light-medium skin, natural makeup, and pink lipstick. She wears a pale green ribbed top, blue denim jeans, a thin gold necklace with a small pendant, and a white manicure. She leans naturally over the grey leather driver-seat headrest with one arm resting on it and her hand near her cheek, looking toward the camera. Outside the passenger window, night lights, buildings, vehicles, and streetlamps blur softly. Use warm directional streetlamp and interior light, cool blue denim and grey interior, smartphone 26mm wide lens, f/1.8–2.0, ISO 800–1600, subtle grain, and shallow depth of field.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, exposed chest, sexualized lean, exaggerated anatomy, nudity, luxury brand logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, eyes, hair, car interior, night palette, denim, and lighting; replace car brand with an unbranded luxury sedan if needed. No logo or typography is required.
